Restated before interest: ABBV paid $3,002mm of interest inside operating cash flow over 2025, 4.91% of revenue. Restated at replacement capex: ABBV spent $1,214mm on plant over 2025 against $762mm of plant depreciation, 0.74% of revenue above what keeps the plant running.
